grammar.note: 用"是 A,而不是 B"的形式强化对比,是正式的书面表达。

lessonGrammar.name: 时间状语从句 when
lessonGrammar.note: when 引导时间状语从句,置于句首时主句前常用逗号。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: When I discuss my research plan with my supervisor, I learn that a sound study may rest on solid evidence rather than on clever rhetoric.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 当我与导师讨论研究计划时,我认识到,一项扎实的研究依靠的是确凿的证据,而非花哨的言辞。

lessonGrammar.name: 宾语从句 that
lessonGrammar.note: that 引导宾语从句,作 learn 的宾语,that 可省略。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: When I discuss my research plan with my supervisor, I learn that a sound study may rest on solid evidence rather than on clever rhetoric.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 当我与导师讨论研究计划时,我认识到,一项扎实的研究依靠的是确凿的证据,而非花哨的言辞。

lessonGrammar.name: rather than 结构
lessonGrammar.note: rather than 表示"而不是",连接并列成分,本句连接两个 on 短语。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: When I discuss my research plan with my supervisor, I learn that a sound study may rest on solid evidence rather than on clever rhetoric.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 当我与导师讨论研究计划时,我认识到,一项扎实的研究依靠的是确凿的证据,而非花哨的言辞。

lessonGrammar.name: 非限制性定语从句 which/where
lessonGrammar.note: which 修饰 project,where 修饰 metropolis,两个非限制性定语从句层层嵌套,是本单元从句嵌套的典型结构。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: My project, which she may examine with patience, is about the language of a metropolis, where people of every region mix every day.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我的课题,她也许会耐心审阅,是关于一座大都市的语言的,在那里来自各地的人们每天交融相处。

lessonGrammar.name: 从句嵌套
lessonGrammar.note: 主干 is about the language of a metropolis 之后又跟一个 where 从句,拆解时先剥离主干,再处理修饰成分。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: My project, which she may examine with patience, is about the language of a metropolis, where people of every region mix every day.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我的课题,她也许会耐心审阅,是关于一座大都市的语言的,在那里来自各地的人们每天交融相处。
